changelog.name: SpoofMyDevice v2.0.1
changelog.body:
# Bug fix

Sorry, v2.0 included a bug that could prevent hooks from initializing in some apps even when a profile was assigned and the app was enabled in the LSPosed scope. v2.0.1 fixes the profile loading timing issue.

# Change log

- Retry profile loading with a valid application context after Application.attach
- Initialize hooks correctly when early profile loading is unavailable
- Prevent duplicate hook initialization and support runtime profile assignment updates
- Improve tablet navigation with a collapsible Material 3 rail and drawer

changelog.name: SpoofMyDevice 1.1
changelog.body: SpoofMyDevice is an LSPosed companion app for managing spoofed Android device profiles.

readme:
# SpoofMyDevice SpoofMyDevice is an LSPosed / Xposed module for Android device spoofing. It lets you change the device model, brand, fingerprint, system properties, telephony values, and optional display metrics that selected apps can see. ## Screenshots
## Features - Built-in device presets for Pixel, Galaxy, Xiaomi, tablets, and more - Custom profile editing with preset-based starting values - Spoofed `Build.*` fields, system properties, telephony data, and WebView user agent - Optional spoofed display resolution and density - Per-app behavior through LSPosed scope ## Requirements - Android 8.0 or higher - Rooted device - LSPosed installed and active ## How To Use 1. Install the APK. 2. Enable the module in LSPosed. 3. Add target apps to scope. 4. Open SpoofMyDevice and pick a preset or custom profile. 5. Save the profile and restart the target app. ## Package - App package: `com.spoofmydevice` ## Source - Main project: https://github.com/BuSung-dev/SpoofMyDevice

# 欺骗我的设备 SpoofMyDevice 是一个用于 Android 设备欺骗的 LSPosed / Xposed 模块。它允许您更改所选应用程序可以看到的设备型号、品牌、指纹、系统属性、电话值和可选显示指标。 ## 截图
## 特点 - 适用于 Pixel、Galaxy、小米、平板电脑等的内置设备预设 - 使用基于预设的起始值进行自定义配置文件编辑 - 欺骗“Build.*”字段、系统属性、电话数据和 WebView 用户代理 - 可选的欺骗显示分辨率和密度 - 通过 LSPod 范围的每个应用程序行为 ## 要求 - 安卓8.0或更高版本 - 已root的设备 - LSPod已安装并处于活动状态 ## 如何使用 1.安装APK。 2. 在 LSPod 中启用该模块。 3. 将目标应用程序添加到范围。 4. 打开 SpoofMyDevice 并选择预设或自定义配置文件。 5. 保存配置文件并重新启动目标应用程序。 ## 套餐 - 应用程序包：`com.spoofmydevice` ## 来源 - 主要项目：https://github.com/BuSung-dev/SpoofMyDevice
